actions_scaleset.update_policy: manual evidence-reviewed bump only; no floating @latest in production bootstrap
actions_scaleset.wrapper_policy: all upstream client usage must remain behind workspace-control's narrow ci-controller adapter

actions_runner.update_policy: manual evidence-reviewed bump with checksum update and P3/P4 regression before promotion

postgresql_ci_runtime.build_policy: compile from official release source as unprivileged ci-controller; stage before root-owned read-only promotion; no host package/database/service mutation

pgvector_ci_runtime.build_policy: build exact commit against isolated PostgreSQL runtime; stage before root-owned read-only promotion
